selection_policy.article_type_rule: Original research is established before freezing; Comments, Replies, Errata, Corrections, Retractions, Editorials, Reviews, Perspectives, and analogous non-original material are excluded.
selection_policy.identity_rule: The official arXiv record reports the exact canonical Crossref journal DOI. Title, author, topic, numeric, and search-result similarity are metadata checks only and never substitute for DOI identity.
selection_policy.order: Two eligible Nature records in candidate-audit order, followed by all 49 eligible Physical Review Letters volume 137 records in candidate-audit order.
selection_policy.processing: Process all 51 frozen sources without replacement or early stopping.
selection_policy.sampling_interpretation: Operational benchmark-production cohort selected after earlier cohort outcomes were observed; report it separately and do not interpret its conversion rate as preregistered or causal.
selection_policy.source_requirement: A fixed versioned arXiv source response containing at least one strict UTF-8 TeX document.
selection_policy.venue_priority: All eligible Nature candidates precede Physical Review Letters candidates.
